top_categories.workout_context: 194 miles. Your legs will beg to quit after 120. This trains the power output you need from mile 130 onward.
16,568ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Mallorca 312 OK Mobility's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.

Road-specific control matters at Mallorca 312 OK Mobility. Practice on paved mountain and coastal roads: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 194 miles.
At Mallorca 312 OK Mobility, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
85ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
16,568ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 194 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 16,568ft of climbing on paved mountain and coastal roads does to your power file on race day.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on paved mountain and coastal roads can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Mallorca 312 OK Mobility. Train it until it feels boring.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Mallorca 312 OK Mobility. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.

race_overlay.nutrition: Ultra-distance fueling for 194 miles: 80–100g carbs/hour from mile 1 — don’t wait until you’re hungry. Practice your exact race-day nutrition in every long training ride. Carry backup calories. 194 miles burns 8,000–12,000+ calories — you cannot replace them all, but you must try.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Mallorca 312 OK Mobility. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Mallorca 312 OK Mobility rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on paved mountain and coastal roads to build confidence.
